lead_raw_text:
The structure of CuBi crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a cell formula of Cu2Bi2 and four atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies both Bi and Cu centers as 12-coordinate, each surrounded by six Bi and six Cu neighbors within a close-packed-like local arrangement, with neighbor distances of 2.93–3.13 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows 12-vertex Bi and Cu coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces.
